summary: A Tab's count now renders through Count: when it changes, only the changed digits move — the new digit rises in on --ui-duration-base while the old fades in place — and the badge's text stays the plain number, so its accessible name and copy are unchanged. No API change; the badge's size and colours are as before. Adds count to registryDependencies, so a re-sync installs it. A new test asserts the change and was shown failing against the plain number.
